pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
Remember, under the stars of the night
Your smile lit up my world
Your warmth passed through your trembling fingertips
It's still in my heart

[Pre-Chorus]
I can't erase it over time
You're still alive in me

[Chorus]
You were my every moment
Like the day I laughed in tears
Even if I know I can't go back
I still love you

[Verse 2]
When it rains, I think of you
My hidden heart in the umbrella cries
Even if memories are scattered by the wind
Only your name won't disappear

[Pre-Chorus]
Longing comes rushing like a wave
Wet my chest again

[Chorus]
You were all my dreams
You were beautiful even in painful love
I have no choice but to look at it from afar
I still love you

[Bridge]
If we can meet again someday
I want to hold you without saying anything
When I close my eyes, I hear your voice
I love you, I still love you

[Final Chorus]
You are my eternal song
Our story never ends
A heart that won't change even if the world stops
A sad love story with you
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.

pkg.youtubeDescription:
✨ EP.06 Remember opens under a night of starlight, where one smile brightened an entire world and a trembling touch left warmth that still lives on. It is a gentle invitation into memories that refuse to fade.

💭 The emotion here is quiet and deep—the kind of longing that arrives like a wave, the hidden tears under an umbrella, and the bittersweet beauty of a love you can only watch from afar now. Even knowing there is no way back, the heart keeps saying I still love you.

🎵 As a POP Original Song, this piece stays soft, modern, and emotional, carrying clear duet warmth and a calm reflective close that never turns aggressive or loud.

💬 Starlights, does this song take you back to someone or somewhere you still remember? Drop a comment and let us feel it with you.
